posts.trend: India Drives Global Growth in Premium Liquor Segment Despite Market Slowdown
posts.context: The standard Friday night group plan at thirty has collapsed into finding the path of least physical resistance.
posts.angle: Social outings are no longer about showing up; they are about avoiding noise and sitting down.
slides: "Bhai, Friday ko milte hain, but somewhere quiet."

"Bhai, bohot loud hai, can't hear anything."

"That premium cocktail place?"

"₹900 a drink before tax, aur baithne ki jagah bhi nahi hai."

"My place?"

"Haan, wahan chupchaap baithte hain."

Everyone is asleep by ten.

While the Uber driver is still searching for the OTP.
posts.caption: You know who you are, and so does your orthopedic mattress. 🛌
posts.rank_verdict: Relying entirely on dialogue in the first two slides abandons the signature deadpan narrative voice of the account in favor of a screenplay script.
